integrity.proof_method: equivariant combinatorial Alexander duality and an integral cellular cochain quotient; exact Hom–Ext computation

scientific_limitations: The assertion classifies integral reduced homology and a natural group representation; it does not classify the homotopy type for arbitrary branching trees.
The nonsplit extension is an equivariant Ext-class and does not indicate torsion in the underlying homology.
Comparisons with accessible scientific results do not exclude equivalent unindexed work.
